mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and can prolong QT interval, while fentanyl is a potent CNS depressant and mu-opioid agonist that can cause respiratory depression and arrhythmias, particularly with electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor electrolytes closely, assess QT interval with ECG, reduce fentanyl dose if needed, monitor respiratory function, and consider alternative antivirals if feasible.
